info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts Payment Terms API

items.docs: Creates a new payment term in AppZen. Returns a uuid for this payment term. When there already exists a payment term (with the same payment_term_id), then the operation is an update (in this case, the `status` in the response will be `UPDATED`).

params.name: uuid
params.description: Globally unique identifier for an uploaded document

items.docs: Returns the details of a payment-term by uuid
Returns the details of a payment-term with specific payment-term-id
